title: Thai Pecan Hash
description: A crunchy Thai hash made with crispy pecans and a nutty flavor.

ingredients.name: Pecans
ingredients.notes: Toasted pecans add a nice crunch to this Thai snack.

ingredients.name: Hash
ingredients.notes: A traditional Uruguayan accompaniment to many meals.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Adds a rich and creamy flavor to the hash.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: A spicy and aromatic paste made from Thai chilies.

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: A squeeze of fresh lime juice adds a nice brightness to the dish.

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: A fragrant and flavorful herb commonly used in Thai cuisine.

instructions: 2. In a large pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
3. Add the diced hash and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
4. In a separate pan, toast the chopped pecans over medium heat until fragrant and lightly browned.
5. In a large bowl, combine the cooked hash, toasted pecans, Thai red curry paste, and chopped cilantro.
6. Squeeze the lime juice over the top and toss to combine.
